scope: Independent appearance review of the final exported skin at whole-head size, including inspection at close-up scale.
findings: Fringe and hairline PASS. Two tapered central locks overlap. The temples frame the cheeks, and the former forehead slash and scattered dark flecks are absent.
Ponytails PASS. Both high violet ties, S-shaped silhouettes, outer prongs and inward hooks are legible. The exposed broad tail surfaces are free of long black slits.
Rear cap and nape PASS. The swept bands cross the center continuously. The reviewer saw no vertical center seam or obvious flat shading on the lower cap.
remaining: At close-up scale there is a shallow triangular pinch where the side lock meets the temple, and a small angular notch above the right ear along the nape. Some tips remain mildly angular. The curls have fewer overlapping locks and the tie edges are softer than in the illustration. The reviewer accepted the whole-head appearance. All requested gates passed.

earlier_review.observations: Blunt merged center bangs, a slash on the right forehead lock and bulbous lower curls. The final renders were reviewed again after repair.
